totp.title: Two-step verification
totp.hint: Enter the {length}-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.

enroll.title: Set up the authenticator app
enroll.intro: Scan this code with your authenticator app to add this account, then type the first code it shows.
enroll.qrAlt: QR code to scan with the authenticator app
enroll.manual: Cannot scan it? Enter the key by hand
enroll.secretLabel: Secret to enter in the app

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.hint: Write down these {count} codes and keep them somewhere safe. Each one works only once and they will never be shown again, not even after reloading the page.

mfa.codeRequired: Enter a verification code or a recovery code.
mfa.invalidCode: Enter the {length} digits shown by the app.
mfa.unreachable: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection.
mfa.retryIn: Too many attempts: try again in {minutes} min.
mfa.forbidden: The superadmin can only sign in from the console network.
mfa.enrollmentChanged: The setup was changed in the meantime: the secret shown is no longer valid. Start again, then scan the new code in the app.

reset.title: Two-factor authentication
reset.hint: Removes the authenticator app and the recovery codes from this account. You will be signed out, and the next sign-in will ask you to set it up again.
